about: Links from plan findings and plan operators to pages on sqlly.app. Paths are site-relative. A link with engines applies to those engines only (sqlserver, postgres, mysql, mariadb, oracle, sqlite, duckdb, clickhouse); a link without engines applies to all. type is article, function, setting, snippet or tool. Every key must have links or a none reason. server/Sqlly.Tests/PlanLearnLinksTests.cs checks every path and fragment against the site.
